verdict.rationale: Wise publishes a formal global versioning policy. It uses calendar-based versioning (CalVer) selected in the URL, with quarterly releases and Latest/Active/Preview/Legacy version types. It also includes a dedicated deprecation-and-sunset section and defines breaking versus non-breaking changes, backed by yearly changelogs and a dated Sandbox V1 deprecation. The policy explicitly excludes webhooks and sensitive card details endpoints. missing for 10: versioning/deprecation coverage for webhooks and sensitive card endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of how the deprecation policy works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Wise Platform uses global, calendar-based versioning (CalVer)
Wise maintains yearly API changelogs (2023/2024/2025) with dated detail pages for specific changes, complementing the CalVer policy.
